thread:
Harper Stone: Quick alignment for tomorrow's launch comms. Blog draft ready, but ops needs a green light for the publish window. Can we confirm windows and who is on standby?
Noah Reed: Ops confirmed deploy slot 10:00 AM ET. I'll run the preflight at 09:30 and post the live URL to #marketing immediately after.
Leah O'Connor: PR: short reporter list ready. Plan: T-5 embargo package, T0 publish, T+10 press outreach. Are we keeping CEO quote delayed?
Samir Gupta: Legal: please use "observed in our tests" for benchmark language. CEO quote approved but hold to T+15 to let outlets digest.
Harper Stone: Social schedule?
Leah O'Connor: Organic at T+8, explainer thread at T+18, paid at T+40. Will queue captions now, final tweak after hero image.
Samir Gupta: Design uploaded hero_final_v2.png to /shared/launch-assets. OG/meta tags checked.
pressbot: Shortlink created: https://press.redwood.ai/nov-launch -> resolves at 10:00 AM ET. Healthcheck OK.
Noah Reed: If shortlink fails, fallback: send live URL via secure DM to PR and delay batch send until link stability confirmed.
Harper Stone: Checklist: 09:30 preflight -> Noah, 09:45 legal final -> Samir, 09:50 design confirm -> Leah, 09:55 send embargo -> Leah, 10:00 publish -> commops-bot. Everyone standby 09:25-10:15.
commops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 09:50 AM ET to #marketing. Will post publish webhook on success.
Leah O'Connor: Noted. I'll be on the send. Anything else?
Harper Stone: One more: include erratum contact line in email: press@redwood.inference. If anybody sees an early publish, ping #marketing and we will respond with the rapid plan.
Leah O'Connor: Got it. See you all tomorrow. :rocket:
